x-changelog.summary: Mark due_date and task_item_category as nullable in Task Item schemas
x-changelog.description: The due_date and task_item_category fields on task_item normal and extended schemas now correctly declare nullable: true, reflecting that null values are valid and can be explicitly set via PATCH /task_items/{id} (by sending due_date: null or task_item_category_id: null). This is a spec correction — the API has always returned null for tasks without a due date or category.

x-changelog.summary: Replace Task Item Attachment by Reference
x-changelog.description: Replace existing attachments by image, drawing revision, file version, form, or direct upload ids.

x-changelog.summary: Update Task Item Attachments by Reference
x-changelog.description:
Updated the UPDATE request so attachments by image, drawing revision, file version, form, and direct upload ids are additive.
  - Will not replace existing attachments
  - Will ignore BodyRequest key: task_item[attachment_ids]

The request body can now include a 'task_item[assignee_ids][]' array key to specify multiple assignees. 
This enhancement allows for the assignment of multiple individuals to a task at once. 
Please note, if the 'task_item[assignee_ids][]' key is present, the 'task_item[assigned_id]' key will be ignored.

Update Task Item endpoint now receives an optional 'task_item[distribution_member_ids]' field to assign distribution members to the task item being updated.
Distribution members are now returned in the success response.
